params._approved: True to approve, False to revoke.

claim().details: It is not suggested to use this function directly. Rather `claimWithRange`  will tend to be more gas efficient when used with values from `getSuggestedClaimRange`.

claimFor(address).details: It is not suggested to use this function directly. Rather `claimWithRange`  will tend to be more gas efficient when used with values from `getSuggestedClaimRange`.

claimWithRange(uint256,uint256).details: IMPORTANT: Choosing a `_claimStartWeek` that is greater than the earliest week in which a user may claim. Will result in the user being locked out (total loss) of rewards for any weeks prior.

params._claimEndWeek: the max week in which to search for and claim rewards.
params._claimStartWeek: the min week to search and rewards.

claimWithRangeFor(address,uint256,uint25.details: WARNING: Choosing a `_claimStartWeek` that is greater than the earliest week in which a user may claim will result in the user being locked out (total loss) of rewards for any weeks prior.Useful to target specific weeks with known reward amounts. Claiming via this function will tend  to be more gas efficient when used with values from `getSuggestedClaimRange`.

params._account: Account of which to make the claim on behalf of.
params._claimEndWeek: The max week in which to search for and claim rewards.
params._claimStartWeek: The min week to search and rewards.

computeSharesAt(address,uint256).details: IMPORTANT: This calculation cannot be relied upon to return strictly the users weight against global weight as it implements custom logic to ignore the first week of each deposit.Computing shares in past weeks is accurate. However, current week computations will not  be accurate until week is finalized.Results scaled to PRECSION.

params._recipient: Wallet to receive rewards on behalf of the account. Zero address will result in all  rewards being transferred directly to the account holder.

params._rewardToken: address of reward token to be used.
params._staker: the staking contract to use for weight calculations.

params._amount: the amount of reward token to deposit.

getSuggestedClaimRange(address).details: This function is designed to be called prior to ranged claims to shorten the number of iterations required to loop if possible.

pushRewards(uint256).details: In rare circumstances, rewards may have been deposited to a week where no adjusted weight exists. This function allows us to recover rewards to the current week.

params._week: the week to push rewards from.
the week to push rewards from.

returns._0: uint representing rewards amount that is pushable.

approveClaimer(address,bool).notice: Allow account to specify addresses to claim on their behalf.

claim().notice: Claim all owed rewards since the last week touched by the user.

claimFor(address).notice: Claim on behalf of another account. Retrieves all owed rewards since the last week touched by the user.

claimWithRange(uint256,uint256).notice: Claim rewards within a range of specified past weeks.

claimWithRangeFor(address,uint256,uint25.notice: Claim on behalf of another account for a range of specified past weeks.

computeSharesAt(address,uint256).notice: Helper function used to determine overall share of rewards at a particular week.

configureRecipient(address).notice: User may configure their account to set a custom reward recipient.

depositReward(uint256).notice: Allow permissionless deposits to the current week.

getClaimable(address).notice: Get the sum total number of claimable tokens for a user across all his claimable weeks.

getClaimableAt(address,uint256).notice: Get the reward amount available at a given week index.

getSuggestedClaimRange(address).notice: Helper function returns suggested start and end range for claim weeks.

getTotalClaimableByRange(address,uint256.notice: Returns sum of tokens earned with a specified range of weeks.

pushRewards(uint256).notice: Push inaccessible rewards to current week.

pushableRewards(uint256).notice: Helper view function to check if any rewards are pushable.
